title: Entity header
responsibility: Shows entity identity, verification and navigation between overview, details and history.

inputs.name: EntityHeader.entity
inputs.description: Required name, category, role, purpose, verdict and optional app route/change. Removed entities receive a removed-at-commit badge. Page route links are enabled only for nonempty routes without bracket, colon, asterisk or parameter-pattern characters checked here.

inputs.name: EntityHeader.nav
inputs.description: Required current route and link/navigation functions. Section selects the overview/details tab row; unrecognized tabs fall back to the first, while history remains selected in its section.

inputs.name: EntityHeader.shared
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default, displaying a Shared badge.

inputs.name: EntityHeader.preview
inputs.description: Optional persistent preview rendered between entity identity and the tabs, including Details and History.

outputs.name: EntityHeader
outputs.description: Breadcrumbs, category icon, name/role/verdict and purpose or details summary. Pages show an openable app route or nonlinked pattern/Not recorded. Offers Details or Back to overview and the appropriate tab row. Navigation retains context through the route helper. An optional preview remains above every tab row.
